neighbours.label: the words 'rave' / 'raving' / 'raved', 'Vantage' / 'vantage' and 'Wii' (a list: spelling neighbours such as wave, cave, advantage stay quiet)
fire: Reviewers were raving about the little bakery on Mill Street all summer.
Thousands of teens flocked to a warehouse rave near Manchester that weekend.
Every guest at dinner raved about the lamb and the wine.
Our office moved to 210 Vantage Drive in the fall.
The hilltop offers a fine vantage over the whole bay.
Nintendo sold millions of the Wii during its first holiday season.
My cousin still plays bowling on an old Wii in his basement.
Police shut down the rave before midnight and sent everyone home.
